I automated our fragmented and manual release notes process using Python scripts and use of agent skills supported by large language models, reducing writer input time from almost a week to less than a day.

## Situation

At the end of my tenure at ValidMind, the volume of our release notes required a writer to spend almost a week:

- Collating and verifying information on features for multiple products in our offering from many competing sources, including cloud storage, project management boards, and scattered GitHub repositories.
- Creating multiple versions of release notes, one for public consumption, and one tailored for on-prem customers.
